posts.author: Kiranyaki
posts.body:
Welcome RPG Makers~​
This is a collection of RPG Maker MV/MZ plugins that we made for various projects. We wish to share them with our fellow RPG Maker users.
The goal of our library is to provide small and useful utility scripts for RPG Maker games. The primary focus being adventure, cozy or even horror games. They can be used for normal RPGs too!
We’ll keep updating with new plugins as we finish or polish them for public use.
Plugin List​
Kiranyaki_4_Single_Frame
: Allows you to use a single image as a character in game if they have [SF] on the filename.
More coming soon!
